pairs.question: An cuiuslibet auris est exigere litterarum sonos?
pairs.derivation: Authorial rhetorical question with its own immediate reply. Stripped the section marker 'VII.' preceding the question. Question kept whole; answer is the contiguous first (and complete) sentence of the reply 'Non hercule magis quam nervorum' ('No, by Hercules, no more than [the ear judges] the sounds of strings'), which directly answers the question in the negative. What follows ('Aut grammatici saltem omnes in hanc descendent rerum tenuitatem...') turns to a new point and is excluded.
